# Donor Retention Benchmarks for Nonprofits

Based on the latest 2026 data, here are the key donor retention benchmarks for nonprofits:

## Overall Retention Rates

| Metric | Rate |
|--------|------|
| **Overall Average** | 54.73% (2026 Virtuous data) |
| **Top Quartile Performance** | 69.64% |
| **Industry Range** | 31.9% - 54.73% (varies by source and methodology) |

*Note: Different sources report varying averages (ranging from 31.9% to 54.73%) depending on their data collection methodology and nonprofit sample sizes.*

## Key Benchmarks by Donor Type

- **First-to-Second Gift Conversion**: 25.84% overall; 37.86% top quartile
- **Repeat Donor Retention**: 69.2% average
- **New Donor Retention**: 14-19.63% average
- **Recurring Monthly Givers**: Up to 90% retention

## Retention Rate Performance Tiers

| Retention Rate | Performance Level |
|---|---|
| Below 40% | Needs serious attention |
| 40–55% | Average (majority of organizations) |
| 55–65% | Above average |
| 69.64%+ | Top quartile excellence |

## Small Nonprofit Goals
For organizations with fewer than 1,000 donors, realistic targets are **35–45%**.

## Cost Efficiency
Retaining existing donors costs only **$0.20 per dollar raised**, making retention highly cost-effective compared to donor acquisition.
